info.title: FYNX API
info.description: Deterministic trading calculations, market hours and account-rule monitoring. All calculations use the data you send; FYNX does not fetch prices for these routes. Decimal inputs may be sent as strings to avoid floating-point loss.

tags.name: Risk
tags.description: Forex position sizing, pip value, margin, risk/reward, break-even and ATR stops from caller-supplied contract data.

tags.name: Indicators
tags.description: Technical indicators and multi-symbol screening on caller-supplied prices.

tags.name: Market Hours
tags.description: Exchange status, published holidays and forex sessions.

tags.name: Prop Firm Rules
tags.description: Versioned evaluation rules, ordered account events and eligibility with audit history.
